## Purpose and entry points
This is the .NET EF Core repository: an object–database mapper plus the independent Microsoft.Data.Sqlite ADO.NET provider. Primary consumer APIs are `DbContext`, `DbSet`, model configuration, LINQ, and `SaveChanges` in `src/EFCore/DbContext.cs`, `src/EFCore/DbSet.cs`, and `src/EFCore/ModelBuilder.cs`. Provider packages adapt the common runtime to specific stores. Command-line design operations enter through `src/dotnet-ef/Program.cs` and `src/ef/Program.cs`.

## Core runtime and model construction
`EFCore` is the provider-agnostic kernel. `DbContext` composes options, an internal DI service provider, database services, model, state manager, and query compiler. The model is built from CLR types, Fluent API, attributes, and conventions, then cached and initialized into runtime metadata.
- `src/EFCore/Infrastructure/EntityFrameworkServicesBuilder.cs`
- `src/EFCore/Infrastructure/ModelSource.cs`
- `src/EFCore/Metadata/Conventions/Internal/ConventionDispatcher.cs`

## Change tracking and write orchestration
Entity operations attach graphs and maintain identity maps, snapshots, relationship fixup, key propagation, and state transitions. `SaveChanges` converts tracked entries through the common update adapter; provider databases execute persistence. Interceptors and diagnostics cross-cut this boundary.
- `src/EFCore/ChangeTracking/Internal/StateManager.cs`
- `src/EFCore/ChangeTracking/Internal/ChangeDetector.cs`
- `src/EFCore/Update/Internal/UpdateAdapter.cs`

## Query compilation pipeline
LINQ on `DbSet` produces expression trees. The core query compiler parameterizes/normalizes expressions, expands navigations, invokes provider translation stages, compiles shaped results, and caches compiled queries. Providers own store-expression generation and materialization execution.
- `src/EFCore/Query/Internal/QueryCompiler.cs`
- `src/EFCore/Query/Internal/NavigationExpandingExpressionVisitor.cs`
- `src/EFCore/Query/ShapedQueryCompilingExpressionVisitor.cs`

## Relational shared layer
`EFCore.Relational` is the extensibility layer shared by SQL providers. It adds relational model mappings, SQL expression trees and generation contracts, ADO.NET connection/command/transaction abstractions, batching-based updates, migrations, and reverse-engineering contracts.
- `src/EFCore.Relational/Query/RelationalQueryableMethodTranslatingExpressionVisitor.cs`
- `src/EFCore.Relational/Storage/RelationalConnection.cs`
- `src/EFCore.Relational/Update/Internal/CommandBatchPreparer.cs`

## Store providers and boundaries
SQL Server and SQLite extend relational services with dialect translation, type mappings, migrations, connections, and update SQL. Cosmos is a separate document-store pipeline with Cosmos SQL translation, JSON serialization, transactional batches, session tokens, and SDK-facing client wrapping. In-memory implements query and storage without an external database.
- `src/EFCore.SqlServer/Query/Internal/SqlServerQuerySqlGenerator.cs`
- `src/EFCore.Sqlite.Core/Query/Internal/SqliteQuerySqlGenerator.cs`
- `src/EFCore.Cosmos/Storage/Internal/CosmosClientWrapper.cs`
- `src/EFCore.InMemory/Storage/Internal/InMemoryStore.cs`

## Design-time, SQLite driver, and delivery
Design-time services activate application contexts, scaffold migrations/models, generate C#, and support compiled/precompiled artifacts. `Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core` is the underlying ADO.NET SQLite driver; EF SQLite depends on this boundary rather than directly on SQLite APIs. Builds target .NET via MSBuild, package NuGet artifacts, and run Azure DevOps/GitHub CI; functional suites exercise SQL Server, SQLite, Cosmos emulator/service configuration, and in-memory paths.
- `src/EFCore.Design/Design/OperationExecutor.cs`
- `src/Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core/SqliteConnection.cs`
- `azure-pipelines.yml`
